observations: Photo 0: close-up of a wrapped photocopier top/side showing 'SHARP' and 'AR-M207' nameplate, still in plastic wrap, text overlay 'SMATECH MEGA EQUIPMENT'.
Photo 1: side view of the machine, wrapped in plastic, paper tray labels 'A4' and 'A3' visible, 'digital' logo sticker visible, same nameplate 'AR-M207' partially visible.
Photo 2: another angled wrapped view, same nameplate visible, no screen, no power cable, no printed test page shown.
No photo shows the unit powered on, a test print, toner level, drum condition, or page counter.

claims.evidence: No import sticker, UK plug, or documentation shown in any photo; claim rests on seller's words alone.

claims.claim: Packed with an extensive range of superb performance functions, delivering...
claims.evidence: Marketing language, no photo shows functioning screen, print output, or feature demonstration.

risks.risk: Machine may not power on or may have internal faults (common with 'London used' copiers sold as-is).
risks.proof: Video clip of unit powered on with a test copy/print produced.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / for parts

risks.risk: Drum, toner, and fuser condition unknown; these are costly consumables/parts on copiers.
risks.proof: Photo of internal drum unit and toner cartridge, plus a sample printed page.

risks.risk: Physical condition (scratches, cracks, missing panels) hidden by plastic wrap.
risks.proof: Photos with wrap fully removed from all sides.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically worn, worst case

risks.risk: Page counter / usage history unknown, affecting remaining lifespan.
risks.proof: Photo of the page counter display or service sticker.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powered on producing a test copy.
Photos with the plastic wrap removed, showing all sides and the control panel.
Photo of the drum unit and toner cartridge condition.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Sharp AR-M207 photocopier from the nameplate in photos 0-2, but no functional test is shown, so it must be priced at worst case (unverified working condition); the only true brand/tier comparable available is the Sharp AR-M160 listing.
